annotations.title: FLUX Fill Pro inpainting and outpainting

description: Repaint part of an image with a mask, or extend it outwards (zoom out, make square, add a side), matching the original. One flat price. Compared with other image tools: premium. Price: $0.069 per image, charged only on success. One call = one image.

image.description: Image to change (https URL). Or send the file inline as a base64 data: URI (up to 4.5 MB)

mask.description: Optional black-and-white mask (https URL): white areas are repainted. Or send the file inline as a base64 data: URI (up to 4.5 MB)

outpaint.description: Extend the image instead of using a mask. Default None
